problem: GitHub website checks could be green while Netlify production failed because the website lane did not execute the same build command as netlify.toml.
root_cause: Pre-merge website validation omitted production-critical build stages including pricing-build-integrity capture/restore, apply-i18n and build-localized-routes. The CI candidate was therefore not build-equivalent to the Netlify production candidate.
prevention: Every website candidate that requires preview must execute the exact Netlify production build chain before merge.
The parity job must include pricing-build-integrity capture and restore, apply-i18n, build-localized-routes, sitemap generation and release-evidence generation.
Production-like i18n environment values must be explicit in the parity job so build behavior is deterministic.
A green browser test built from a reduced composer is not sufficient evidence of Netlify buildability.
Terminal closure still requires exact production SHA and production browser proof after Netlify deployment.

evidence.provider_error: Build script returned non-zero exit code: 2
evidence.premerge_gap: website lane omitted production i18n/pricing build stages
